privacy.sec1.title: 01. Data Collection & Knowledge Architecture
privacy.sec1.body:
nodetask collects only essential telemetry and content payloads necessary to construct hierarchical document trees using PostgreSQL ltree.
Your document ASTs and block attributes are isolated per workspace and protected by strict organization-level Access Control (RBAC).
privacy.sec2.title: 02. Session Token Encryption & Auth Guard
privacy.sec2.body:
Authentication tokens and user credentials are encrypted using industry-standard cryptographic algorithms.
All active sessions, session refresh tokens, and Serverpod RPC request headers enforce HTTPS TLS 1.3 transport encryption.
privacy.sec3.title: 03. User Privacy Rights & RBAC Policy
privacy.sec3.body:
Users retain full ownership of created knowledge workspaces. SYSTEM_ADMIN, ORG_ADMIN, ORG_MEMBER, and USER roles are strictly bound by RBAC access policies.
We never sell, rent, or trade personal data or internal documentation to third parties.
privacy.sec4.title: 04. Data Retention, Export & Policy Updates
privacy.sec4.body:
Workspace administrators can export document ASTs in standard JSON or markdown formats at any time.
Upon workspace deletion request, all PostgreSQL ltree records and vector embeddings are permanently purged within 30 days.
privacy.callout.title: [ ZERO-RETENTION COMMITMENT ]
privacy.callout.body: Your document AST trees are stored strictly for workspace operations. nodetask never performs unauthorized third-party tracking or AI model training on customer private AST nodes.
